pages.text: $(l)Automate Quartz Fiber$() using the Crafting Core with Packaged Automation, mirroring your Basic/Advanced/Elite table automation.
Avoid power buffering—running out of power causes immediate failure and makes issues easier to diagnose.
For early grinding, use the Industrial Grinder and skip the TNT-based recipe in other Tech Reborn machines to avoid rapid gunpowder consumption.
Use XNet or split EnderIO conduit lines to route items to multi-blocks/furnaces; avoid overloading a single extraction line.
Configure an Anihilation Plane subnet to only insert peat into bog earth setups; TCK acceleration speeds this up.
For Mystical Agriculture, hold Yellorium and Platinum essences instead of crafting them early—use them later for Quantum Bridge or gems.
Side-specific furnaces (e.g., Red Matter, Supremium) only accept input/output from designated sides—check JEI or the block model for orientation.
To upgrade slow circuit passives, triple their count to meet throughput demands.
The first hundred freed Betrayed Souls is a satisfying early milestone and key for automation progression.
Don’t automate mythic essences for miners in mid-to-late Chapter 3; rush Sednanite instead for better recipes, and only batch craft essences long enough to obtain Divine Stars.
If automation slows unexpectedly, consider chunk loading issues or focus-switch lag—most issues resolve on reload or chunk re-entry.
$(l)Spectre coils must be the power-producing variant$()—using the consumption variant for generation will drain power instead of creating it.
